$description: Glass skin, applied with data-skin="glass". Floating surfaces turn translucent over a blurred backdrop, with a light rim along their top edge, a wide soft shadow and softer, rounder corners. The translucent layer (glass.translucent.json) applies only where the browser blurs the backdrop and the person has not asked for reduced transparency; elsewhere the same surfaces stay solid, with the rim and the corners.

panel.$description: 16px: a pane of glass reads as one soft-edged sheet.

highlight.$description: A one pixel rim of light along the top edge, where light catches the pane.

ambient.$description: A wide soft shadow under every pane, cards included, so the sheets float above the washed canvas.

wash.$description: A full wash of the blue and cyan identity tints in pools at the canvas corners and foot: the colour the panes pick up and blur.
